title: Tenma Tsukasa — Sinking Into Despair〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: ArcLand
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Here we aaare!
Let's all work hard at the workshop!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. There are only a few days left, after all. Let's not slack off, and learn as much as we can!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's good that you two are motivated and all...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But we're here really early. The workshop classes don't start for another hour.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We decided to run here to build stamina right after morning practice, but it seems we arrived earlier than anticipated.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! It only goes to show how excited we are!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Either way, what should we do? It would be nice to find someplace to pass the time...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... In that case, why don't we enjoy a relaxing morning tea at my usual spot!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You have a usual spot?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! In the north section of the park!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's away from the central area, so it's usually not crowded. We can rest there without getting in the way of any park guests.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It's this way!
Follow me!
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I don't think I've ever been to the north area.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Neither have I. I always go directly to the workshop venue.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Do you come up this way a lot, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. I go on walks up here during breaks, usually.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh!
Good morning, sir!

rows.Speaker: Cleaner
rows.Line: Well, if it isn't Tsukasa! Got your workshop today?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right. We happened to arrive a little early, so I plan to have tea with my friends!

rows.Speaker: Cleaner
rows.Line: Oh, over at your usual spot? They've started the new seasonal menu, so I hope you all enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, that's exciting to hear! We'll be sure to give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Cleaner
rows.Line:
Okay, you kids take care.
Good luck with the workshop!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Let's speak again sometime soon!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...
Tsukasa seemed really friendly with that person!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Here we are, my go-to cafe!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? It looks like a gift shop...
Oh, they have tables to sit and drink tea too.

rows.Speaker: Vendor
rows.Line: I know that voice... Hello there, Tsukasa! Good to see you again.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I've brought my friends today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hello there!

rows.Speaker: Vendor
rows.Line: Hello to you too! Let's see... Emu, Nene, Rui. Is that right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You know who we are?

rows.Speaker: Vendor
rows.Line: I've heard a lot about you from Tsukasa. You're all participating in the workshop, right?

rows.Speaker: Vendor
rows.Line: Our workshops are pretty intense, but good luck. I hope it'll be a good experience for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh wow, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: From your conversations with this person and the cleaner from before... You certainly seem to have become close with the staff here, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh, now that you mention it... I wonder when that started?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I figured that, since we'd be guests of ArcLand, it would be proper to say hello to the staff... And before I knew it...

rows.Speaker: Vendor
rows.Line: Haha. You were always so energetic and greeted us with such a loud voice, we all just naturally started recognizing you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hahaha, that's Tsukasa, alright!

rows.Speaker: Vendor
rows.Line: Hearing about your shows and all the training you're doing has been my little worktime treat lately.

rows.Speaker: Vendor
rows.Line: But, well... That does make me a little sad, too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Vendor
rows.Line: Well, you said the workshop will be ending soon, right? Pretty soon I won't be able to hear your stories anymore.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's true, I won't be able to come by as often as before...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But... I will come back to see you!

rows.Speaker: Vendor
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: ArcLand is a wonderful park. I still have so much to learn here as an actor!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So of course I'll come back again, and when I do, I promise to come by and say hello!

rows.Speaker: Vendor
rows.Line:
Tsukasa...
Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Vendor
rows.Line: Well, you have to get through the workshop first.

rows.Speaker: Vendor
rows.Line: I hope you'll stop by before you leave and give me some good news!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course! We'll achieve great results and come by to tell you all about it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We'll all come back, together!

rows.Speaker: Vendor
rows.Line: Haha, thank you. I'm looking forward to it already.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I had already intended to work hard for these last few days... But now I have even more reason to!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's work really hard, so we can give him good news and he can tell us we did a good job!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And the first step toward that is to enjoy our teatime to the fullest!
Excuse me! We're ready to order!
